verses.text: At the turn of the year, when kings usually go out to war, Joab led out the army, devastated the Ammonite countryside, and laid siege to Rabbah. David stayed in Jerusalem. Joab attacked Rabbah and captured it.
David took the crown off their king's head. It weighed a talent of gold and was set with precious stones. The crown was placed on David's head, and he carried a great deal of plunder out of the city.
David brought the people out of the city and had them cut with saws, iron picks, and axes. He did the same to all the Ammonite cities. Then David and all his people returned to Jerusalem.
Later, war broke out with the Philistines at Gezer. Sibbecai the Hushathite killed Sippai, one of the giant's descendants, and the Philistines were subdued.
When war broke out with the Philistines again, Elhanan son of Jair killed Lahmi, the brother of Goliath from Gath. The shaft of Lahmi's spear was as thick as a weaver's beam.
In another battle at Gath there was a huge man with twenty-four fingers and toes, six on each hand and six on each foot. He too was descended from the giant.
When he defied Israel, Jonathan son of Shimea, David's brother, killed him.
These men were descendants of the giant in Gath. They fell at the hands of David and his men.
